visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use this Instead of the Object's Name
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The method refers to its own object by the variable name counter, which breaks if the object is copied or renamed. Use this. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: this refers to whichever object the method was called on, so the same method works if the object is copied, renamed or shared through a prototype.
